title: Talendor (Seasonal)
summary: Talendor pressures nearby players with flame bursts and repeated random-target attacks.
overview: Talendor pressures nearby players with flame bursts and repeated random-target attacks.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Keep the raid stable through the timer phase, then use the final vulnerability window.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Flameburst pulses every 12 seconds within 60 range.
Every 25 seconds, Incinerate attempts attacks on three randomly chosen hate targets.
At 20% health the scripted timers stop and both one- and two-handed piercing and blunt attacks become more effective.

notes: Approval E289. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
